proposal.summary: An authenticated path traversal vulnerability exists in the ArubaOS web-based management interface, allowing deletion of arbitrary files.
proposal.cwe_quote: path traversal or file inclusion vulnerabilities allow an attacker to access files and directories that are stored outside the web document root.

AV.quote: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability results in the ability to delete arbitrary files in the underlying operating system.
